users.rules: allow read: if request.auth != null; allow write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == userId;

stocks.rules: allow read: if request.auth != null; allow write: if request.auth != null && get(/databases/$(database)/documents/users/$(request.auth.uid)).data.role == 'admin';

price_history.rules: allow read: if request.auth != null; allow write: if false;

holdings.rules: allow read: if request.auth != null && (request.auth.uid == resource.data.userId || get(/databases/$(database)/documents/users/$(request.auth.uid)).data.role == 'admin'); allow write: if false;

transactions.rules: allow read: if request.auth != null && (request.auth.uid == resource.data.userId || get(/databases/$(database)/documents/users/$(request.auth.uid)).data.role == 'admin'); allow write: if false;

simulation.rules: allow read: if request.auth != null; allow write: if request.auth != null && get(/databases/$(database)/documents/users/$(request.auth.uid)).data.role == 'admin';

news.rules: allow read: if request.auth != null; allow write: if request.auth != null && get(/databases/$(database)/documents/users/$(request.auth.uid)).data.role == 'admin';
